infotexts.EventText.Thankyou1: Hello, this is a message from the developer "Einz-chan", I was asked to delivers this message to you.
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou2: "Thank you for playing my mod, i am happy to work on this mod and improve it for the joy of people who supports me."
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou3: "As you can see, the mod is still far from being called finished, originally it was made just for me to add some simple skins to the game."
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou4: "As it goes on, i started learning more and more things that i can do, and now i wanted to add a lot more to this mod than ever, but i am having time issues."
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou5: "Once i finished updating the next patch, you may come back here and accepts more quests from Saki and other NPCs that can spawn on the outpost, but i have yet sufficient items to do something like that yet!"
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou6: "The outpost will also expands and get bigger once enough progress is made, i needed more time to work on more outposts in the future..."
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou7: "That's all i want to say, thank you again for playing my mod and support me, i promise to delivers quality contents for my beloved sensei!"
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou8: "One more thing, if anyone wants to help me with the mod, i will gladly take any kind of support that i can get. At the moment i really need some one who can handle making outpost designs for me. I would also need someone who can draw background items for the outposts."
infotexts.EventText.Thankyou9: That's the end of the message, wow whoever "Einz-chan" was, they must be a really cool person! Maybe i should give them a hand too after i finished my works here on Europa.
infotexts.EventText.Abydos_Shiroko_Bankrob_Tutoria: Let's go to the other room.
First, grab the bag that contains the drill device.
Now bring it to the marked location.
Keep in mind that we need the drill to stay online at ALL time, got it?
Drillings into hard material put stress onto the drill, just watch.
The drill is jammed.\n\nCan you find a wrench and fix it?
You can probably figure it out your self.
Good, but the drill won't stay up forever, so we need to fix it when it's jammed.
That's about it, let's just stick to the plan when we get there.
We'll improvise, no plan is good plan.
I'll be back to the room.
infotexts.EventText.Abydos_Nonomi_Bankrob_Tutorial: Looks like I'll be going too, cya~
infotexts.EventText.Abydos_Shiroko_Bankrob_Tutoria: Pickup drill device from the table.
Installs the device at the marked location.
Use a wrench to fix the broken drill.
